choice_prompt: Which ancient creature should we restore?

options.inspiration: Minnesota trilobite fossils; compound eyes and articulating armor inspire an original living visor-shield.
options.growth: A low three-lobed crawler with a broad eye visor grows into a compact bastion; interlocking plates unfold around the face and paired shovel-like forelimbs brace its stance. No swords or scythes.
options.proposed_role: Physical defender; shielded front, readable side-eye windows and a compact curling silhouette.

options.inspiration: Straight-shelled Ordovician cephalopods from southeastern Minnesota; chambered shell and jet movement inspire original ink-ambush anatomy.
options.growth: A squat chamber-cone youngster grows a long tapering obelisk shell angled above a hooded mantle; two broad grasping fins and a few thick tendrils form a clear triangular base. Ink forms a solid dark veil rather than particle clutter.
options.proposed_role: Mixed ink ambusher: special Rock and water-ink moves with physical Dark pressure under the base pack modern move split; long diagonal shell contrasts the trilobite broad shield.

acquisition_proposal.map_basis: MN_R01 Driftless Trail between Winona and Rochester
acquisition_proposal.scene: A researcher beside the existing Driftless bluff grass offers one specimen from a paired slab. The player can decline studying it or decline final confirmation. The choice commits only after actual key-item delivery.
acquisition_proposal.revival: Rochester courtyard researcher at (20,10), approached from (20,11), restores the chosen specimen at level10 after the Care Badge. A full party leaves the specimen and restoration claim untouched.
acquisition_proposal.inventory: Native key items are retained until givepoke succeeds; each living line has its own saved restoration flag. Failed bag grants do not record the initial choice or the later exchange.
acquisition_proposal.other_choice: After EVENT_MN_LEAGUE_CHAMPION, return to the Driftless researcher for a free once-only exchange granting the unchosen fossil. A full key pocket retains the exchange claim.
acquisition_proposal.runtime_status: Selected fossil_research_revision, content-packs/minnesota-current-fossils-repaired-r15-v01.crystalpack. Three controller cases verify both choices, badge/full-party gates, actual gifts, post-League exchange, level34 evolutions, caught Dex entries and Continue. Earned statewide collection remains unproved.

existing_fossil_line.handling: Retained as a separate prehistoric giant-beaver line; it does not replace either item choice.

sources.title: Minnesota Geological Survey: Fossils
sources.supports: Minnesota trilobites and straight-shelled Ordovician cephalopods; fictional species, types, armor and powers are original.
